text: Healthy living is about more than just avoiding illness; it is a way of life that keeps both your body and mind in good shape. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives you energy throughout the day. Regular exercise, even a simple daily walk, strengthens your heart and reduces stress. Equally important is sleep, as your body needs time to recover and your brain needs rest to stay focused. But don’t forget mental health—taking breaks and talking about your feelings is normal and necessary. Finally, a healthy work-life balance means setting boundaries, so you have time for hobbies and loved ones. Small daily choices can lead to big, lasting changes.
